message: So, it looks like summer is determined to remind us who’s boss, and I can’t say I’m surprised. I’ve been keeping an eye on the heat tips from some reputable folks, and it’s a nice reminder to stay cool and hydrated—easier said than done when you’ve got three kids and a sidewalk that melts before my eyes. Just think of it as my 'I told you so' moment when we all start complaining about the heat. Stay cool, everyone.
